## Death Worm (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Large magical beast (earth)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 98 (7d10+21 plus 7)  
 **Fort** +8, **Ref** +6, **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., burrow 10 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +11 (1d8+6 plus 1d6 acid)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** spit acid, spit lightning  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 13, **Con** 16, **Int** 3, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 5  
 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 23 (cannot be tripped)  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Iron Will, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Perception +7, Stealth +3 (+11 in desert environs); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth in desert environs  

**Special Abilities**

 **Spit Acid (Ex)** Once every 1d4 rounds, a death worm can spit a stream of acid in a 30-foot line; *damage* 4d6 acid, Reflex DC 16 half. The save DC is Constitution based. Death worms are immune to their own acid and that of other death worms.  

 **Spit Lightning (Ex)** Once per minute on a round in which it does not spit acid, a death worm can spit a stroke of lightning in a 20-foot line; *damage* 3d6 electricity, Reflex DC 16 half. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm deserts  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** none
